name: TestcaseSuperclass
summary: Holds in a superclass what several testcase classes have in common, so that shared setup and shared utilities are written once.

roles.name: TestcaseSuperclass
roles.summary: Reuse between testcase classes by inheritance. It is the counterpart of a test helper and the more expensive of the two: it spends the single base class a testcase class has, and it hides in a parent the setup a reader is looking for in the test.
